title: docs(skills): the data skill teaches that a predicate update or delete of a controlled_by_parent detail writes the rows its by-id writes do
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_

Fixes #36285
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用 AI 搭应用的人问到「看得到主记录的人按条件批量改、删明细」时,技能包不再教「只能动到本人录入的行」,改为教「批量与逐条改到的行一致,要么全部生效要么一行不动」。平台行为本身没有变。
- 为什么做:属于权限与共享这条线;你裁定的「批量与逐条一致」已经随上一个改动落地,对外发布的技能包还在教旧规则,这是它欠下的文档跟进。
- 出错会怎样:这次只改两处说明文字,不动运行代码;写错的后果是 AI 照着错误说法搭应用,合并后发现不对可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:技能包属于需你本人批准的内容,请审阅这两处文字后批准并合并。

## What changes

The rule taught is the maintainer's ruling 「A 批量与逐条一致」 as the runtime now implements it (the predicate-write change for `controlled_by_parent` details, already on `main`).

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the `writeRequiresMasterRead: true` bullet under "Writes under `controlled_by_parent`". Before: "The ownership floor (rows you created) still binds predicate and, for both users, on-behalf-of updates and deletes." After: "A predicate (`multi: true`) update or delete writes the rows a by-id write of each would, all matched rows or none. The ownership floor (rows you created) still binds, for both users, on-behalf-of updates and deletes." Only the predicate half moved; the on-behalf-of half is kept word for word (ADR-0090 D10).
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, eval 17: the last sentence of `expected_output` states the same rule. Its `assertions` are unchanged: none of the four `must_contain` strings and none of the four `must_not_contain` strings involved the old wording.
- `.changeset/36285-relationships-predicate-floor.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the one hunk at lines 86 to 92: the sentence an agent will author from.
2. `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, eval 17.

## Tests

Head `eb547b8f3`. No runtime code moves, so no package test suite is owed and no ablation applies (documentation only).

<details><summary>Eval 17 against its own assertions, and the shipped catalog</summary>

- Eval 17 `expected_output` checked against its `assertions`: `must_contain` missing 0 of 4, `must_not_contain` present 0 of 4. The fixture parses as JSON, 25 evals. The repository has no runner that executes eval fixtures; this is the structural check available.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build`, exit 0: "sync-catalog self-test: 9 cases pass", "114 file(s) across 14 skill(s) copied from skills/** into dist/skills and read back byte-identical". In `packages/skills/dist/skills/objectstack-data/`, the new sentence is found once in each of the two files and the old wording "still binds predicate" zero times in `rules/relationships.md` (positive control: `writeRequiresMasterRead` is found there).

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates, local subset</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 48 families from the 3 changed paths. All 48 were run at `eb547b8f3` with each exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` answers "48 derived, 48 run, 0 UNRUN".

- 43 exit 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet` ("60 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings"; `relationships.md` 4188 tokens, ceiling 4203, headroom 15), `check:skill-served-sections`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`.
- 5 exit 3, NOT MEASURED, reason: each needs a full workspace build this documentation diff does not owe locally, and each printed its own prerequisite refusal: `check:doc-formula-expressions` (the formula package is not built), `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. They are left to CI.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Search for other sentences teaching the old rule, at `ed33f8aed`: `git grep -iE 'rows you created|ownership floor' -- skills/` answers the two sites corrected here and no other; `git grep -i predicate -- skills/objectstack-data/` has no other hit about a `controlled_by_parent` write. No generated mirror carries the sentence: `rules/relationships.md` is hand-authored, and `check:skill-served-sections` is green.
- The predicate rule holds for every `controlled_by_parent` detail, not only one that declares `writeRequiresMasterRead`. The sentence stays in the bullet where the old one stood, as the card asks for a rewrite in place with no restructuring.
- The region after line 406 of `relationships.md` (another open draft's) is not touched; the file is 400 lines on this branch.
- `relationships.md` grows by 1 line and 26 tokens, inside its ceiling. Nothing was deleted to pay for it.
- Governed surface (`skills/**`, Tier H): this pull stays draft and requests no reviewer.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- skills/` shows exactly two hunks, one sentence each. Then `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`; expect a last line starting "✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 60 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings".
